name: Axelera Embedded 110m (Metis M.2 AI Accelerator Card) Datasheet
notes: Vendor datasheet states only '1 GB LPDDR4X' — no bandwidth, no DRAM speed grade. Bandwidth left null rather than estimated. Axelera's extended-memory 113m variant uses both AIPU DRAM interfaces to double bandwidth and offers 2/8 GB, but still publishes no GB/s figure.
